label: caiso 92 measured offer
definition: CAISO KEEPER (promoted 2026-07-17, owner sign-off: structurally sound + failing gates improved). caiso-90 keeper recipe + the MEASURED CAISO DAM offer surface (WP-A): the fitted _CAISO_OFFER_CURVE CC_REGULAR/CT_PEAKER econ/peak multipliers are REPLACED by the cap-weighted medians of the fleet's own published DAM energy bids (OASIS Public Bid Data, 90-day-lag masked curves; dam-public-bids intake + derive_caiso_offer_surface.py, all estimation gates PASS) + the condition-binned measured peak-rung ladder, P1-only. A rule-24/25 SHRINK of the fitted offer surface (zero new free parameters; measured bid statistics normalized by the model's own gas-flow-day + CARB inputs; committed band unarmed per rule 19). Scored grid matches the superseded caiso-90 keeper (NOT-YET; C1/C3a/C3c/C4 FAIL, C2/C3b/C5a/C6/C7/C8 PASS) with C3a mean-LMP improved (2024 +11.5->+10.4%, 2025 +15.2->+14.3%; belly overprice down). C1 effect: CT_PEAKER rises via MERIT (Panoche bid wedge releasing) but only ~+0.15-0.34 TWh/yr — the class under-run is confirmed a VOLUME/commitment phenomenon (WP-B), not an offer-price one; the evening-λ leg deepens, disclosed. 2023-2025.
market_story: CAISO is a structurally competitive energy market: the DMM Default Energy Bid holds every gas unit near its cost-based short-run marginal cost, so the fleet offers close to fuel + heat rate + a thin adder — not a strategic scarcity markup. This keeper replaces the model's fitted gas offer multipliers with that measured reality, read straight off the fleet's own published DAM bid curves. CC_REGULAR: the midday-marginal workhorse bids a near-flat body at ~1.05x its measured heat rate (the fitted curve's inflated econ band, which over-priced the CA belly, retires). CT_PEAKER: the class bids a near-flat ~1.18x curve — CAISO's fast-start peakers post cost-based offers and clear on the evening net-load ramp on merit, NOT the 4x scarcity wall the fitted curve carried (a wall the real market never posts and the model never reached). Panoche and the aeroderivative fleet clear more of their real evening/overnight energy as their measured bid now sits at the fuel-only cost that the fitted carbon+multiplier rung had priced out. The residual CT under-run that remains is a volume/commitment gap (real CCs two-shift overnight where the model holds them flat), owned by the WP-B two-shift screen — not the offer surface, which is now the fleet's own measured bid.
